card.text: HAT-P-4 b was found in 2007 by HATNet as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-4b"
sources.quote: HAT-P-4b is a confirmed extrasolar planet orbiting the star HAT-P-4 over 1000 light years away in Boötes constellation.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-4. Its orbit and size follow Torres et al. 2008's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-4b"
sources.quote: It was discovered by transit on October 2, 2007, which looks for slight dimming of stars caused by planets that passed in front of them.
